research_assumptions.policy: Cost-aware funded paired transfers; inherited legacy gradual allocation/scoring parameters are retained for reference but do not drive paired transfer decisions.
research_assumptions.parameter_changes: Trade tape, funded paired policy and explicit untuned paired defaults; 0.5-second decisions; 10 bp common per-side transaction fee; explicit full available 90-day period and USD 100000 trade-replay capital.
research_assumptions.preserved_reference_settings: 100% BTC, regular/linear long-only futures, 100% maximum tape participation, 60-second quote age, zero execution delay, zero custody expense, zero half spread and zero slippage. Legacy allocation/scoring fields are copied unchanged.
research_assumptions.fee_estimate: 10 basis points (0.10%) of executed USD notional per buy or sell on both spot and futures. Existing opening BTC is an endowment, not a newly charged purchase.

fee_sources.rate: Regular-user spot maker/taker 0.100%; no BNB or VIP discount.
Standard futures maker 0.015%, taker 0.035%; nonweekly delivery 0.025%, weekly delivery exempt.

research_assumptions.fee_model_limitation: The current paired engine shares one proportional rate across spot and futures. Applying 10 bp to futures is conservative relative to the published current 3.5 bp taker rate; this is not a reconstructed historical account-tier schedule. Fixed/minimum/per-unit fees remain zero. Expiry delivery fees and cross-venue transfer/FX costs are unmodeled.
research_assumptions.execution: Subsequent observed same-side trade participation, with fully funded linked source/target orders, fractional quantities and no measured order-book depth. Spread/slippage retain the reference preset zero values and are not calibrated.
research_assumptions.forecast: Conditional expected net BTC versus KEEP: flat expected spot, residual futures basis fades linearly toward the configured settlement basis at expiry, latest available cash yield held constant, common horizons bounded by expiry.
research_assumptions.funding: Fully funded USD-linear research proxy, causal cash-interest proxy and scheduled variation settlement; no leverage or native inverse settlement.
research_assumptions.data: Binance BTC/USDT with assumed USDT/USD parity and Deribit inverse USD quote observations as a linear-futures price proxy.
research_assumptions.validation: Three-day accounting and statistics validation. Parameters are unchanged from the full-period paired preset except backtest_end; no tuning.
